hospital.basis: user decision 2026-09-10: a patient who reaches a hospital with an open emergency-room bed is treated successfully (1.0); when no bed is open the hospital is assumed to refuse or hold the patient and only 0.1 of the remaining survival mass is saved (a 119-transported patient is assumed to need a bed). 75-minute bed occupancy and 5-minute transfer delay remain temporary coefficients. Time delay is already penalised through the survival function, so success is not further discounted.

candidate.basis: temporary planning assumption: every new-build candidate is modelled as a 지역응급의료기관 with 20 emergency-room beds, 75-minute bed occupancy and unit cost; not a design or budget figure

ambulance.basis: temporary coefficient copied from scripts/build_folium_municipal_simulator.py; not an observed turnaround time

demand.provincial_population_reference: MOIS resident population 2026-08 (sum of the 31 municipalities in municipality_summary.csv)
demand.basis: observed 2025 municipal 119 dispatch counts from 경기데이터드림 '구급활동 현황' (Sheet query, one row per dispatch, assigned to municipalities by 출동소방서 name because the source SIGUN_CD mislabels 남양주소방서 rows as 41630); annual_dispatches / 365 -> daily_calls; file data/processed/calibration/municipal_daily_calls_2025.csv. Cross-check: NFA 2025 yearbook reports 799,302 Gyeonggi dispatches for 2024 (1.5% lower). Within a municipality the daily total is still allocated to administrative dongs by resident-population share because the source has no incident coordinates.
